Brampton Plan Schedule 6a Wetland areas classified as either provincially significant or unevaluated/other.  Wetlands are areas where water is present at or near the surface for all or part of the year, creating conditions that support specialized vegetation and wildlife habitat. They provide important ecological functions including water filtration, flood attenuation, groundwater recharge, and biodiversity conservation.

This data is intended to be used in conjuction with other related mapping layers for this schedule, and may be impacted by other schedules, with consideration to the text of Brampton Plan.
